cm.title: Customer messages
cm.sub: What customers receive by SMS or WhatsApp at each step of an order. Blue boxes fill in by themselves.
cm.usage: About {n} SMS a month ({cost}) at your current orders. WhatsApp messages are counted separately.
cm.usageNoCost: About {n} SMS a month at your current orders. WhatsApp messages are counted separately.
cm.noText: No words written for this step yet.
cm.bothNote: With both on, WhatsApp goes first and SMS follows only when WhatsApp cannot reach the customer. Nothing is sent to a customer from this page: messages go out only when an order reaches that step.
cm.skipped: This sample order would get no message: {why}

err.STALE: Someone changed this just now. Reload the page and try again.
err.INVALID_INPUT: That is not valid. Check the words and try again.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
err.network: Could not reach the server. Try again.

more.sub: Everything else about customer messages that the shop already has.
more.journeyD: Every step from the order received to the follow-ups after delivery: its switch, channel, fallback, time and orders.
more.templatesD: Every SMS, WhatsApp and e-mail text, each in English and Bengali, with a live preview.
more.channelsD: The master switch, how many messages one customer gets, quiet hours, the SMS and WhatsApp connections.
more.consentD: Who asked to stop and who agreed to messages.
more.ceilingsD: The month's SMS and WhatsApp spend against your ceilings.
more.logD: Every message sent or skipped, with the reason.
more.automationsD: Messages that start on an event, with their own switches and limits.

problem.UNKNOWN_TOKEN: A word in {braces} is not one the shop fills in.
problem.NOT_BENGALI: The Bengali text has no Bengali in it.
problem.AMOUNT_ON_PAID: A fully paid order would get no message: use {amountLine}.
problem.LINK_PROMISE: It promises a link the shop cannot make yet.

reason.NO_LINK: a link it needs cannot be made yet
reason.NO_EVENT: this sample has no such event
reason.UNKNOWN_TOKEN: a blue box is not one the shop knows
